notes: New layer, registered as part of a Context Librarian catalog freshness fix (backend-ci was failing because these 4 files existed on main unregistered). Not yet exercised by a real consumption pilot the way cross_layer_architecture was — confidence is lower than the other 6 layers for that reason, not because the classification itself is in doubt.

cmd_marketing.py is a direct command handler (cmd_update.py/cmd_decision.py style) — not a dispatcher tool and not routed through ActionGateway/ActionContract; it does not participate in the approvals layer's lifecycle.

marketing_brief_composer.py's compose_brief()/compose_production_handoff() are pure, deterministic, no-I/O functions — no AI call and no Airtable access happen in that module; callers (cmd_marketing.py) fetch data and call the AI/Airtable layer themselves.

Domain vocabulary drift is intentional: Marketing Demand's Demand Type field (recruitment/furniture_import/fiber_equipment/real_estate_listing/service) is a Marketing-owned enum selecting a DomainProfile, separate from identity.Domain's canonical business-domain values used by turn_coordinator/core_reasoning — see marketing_domain_profiles.py's own module docstring.
